name: Codex
summary: OpenAI's coding agent runtime; native Agent Skills consumer and one of the two v0.2 live trigger runtimes.

skillDiscovery.skillFormat: directory with a SKILL.md file plus optional scripts and references
documentedLocations: parent directories of $CWD up to the repository root (.agents/skills)
skills bundled with Codex by OpenAI
skillDiscovery.notes: Current Codex documentation lists .agents/skills as the skill location. The Packsmith v0.1 install path ~/.codex/skills (src/lib/targets.mjs) predates this layout; Codex scans .agents/skills in every directory from the working directory up to the repository root and follows symlinked skill folders. Skill state can be disabled without deletion via [[skills.config]] entries (enabled = false) in ~/.codex/config.toml.

frontmatter.notes: SKILL.md must include name and description. Optional interface metadata (display_name, short_description, icons, brand_color, default_prompt), a policy.allow_implicit_invocation flag, and MCP tool dependencies live in agents/openai.yaml, not in SKILL.md frontmatter.
